en.topic_title: Commercial Radio fined HK$120,000 over failure to broadcast hourly news, weather reports
en.topic_summary:
A Hong Kong radio station has been fined HK$120,000 for failing to broadcast certain hourly news and weather reports since 2022, the city’s broadcasting watchdog has said.



Office of the Communications Authority. Photo: OFCA.



Commercial Radio Hong Kong’s (CRHK) English radio channel, AM864, failed to broadcast the reports between May 1, 2022, and April 2, 2026, due to “human error and administrative inadvertence,” according to a Monday statement issued by the Communications Authority
